app_fee.value: Application fee is $75 for international applicants, paid to submit the application.
app_fee.quote: Pay the non-refundable $75 application fee to submit the application

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers go to a short list of groups; international applicants qualify only if they have difficulty paying the application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants are eligible for an application fee waiver from the Office of Graduate Admissions and Recruitment if one of the following criteria applies | I am an International Applicant and am experiencing difficulty submitting the application fee

gre_general.value: The university sets no GRE rule; each program sets its own.
gre_general.quote: Programs set their own requirements for which exams/subjects are required and the minimum scores

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum of 4.0 on the new scale (the old 79 applied to tests through January 2026, so it is not used).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT after January 2026 (Home Edition is accepted): 4.0

english_waiver.value: Applicants with citizenship or a bachelor's degree from India do not need to submit English test scores.
english_waiver.quote: If you have citizenship or a bachelor’s degree from one of the following countries then you do not need to submit scores to meet the English language proficiency requirement | Guyana India Jamaica

notes: Programs may set higher English or GRE requirements; ask the program contact. Applicants exempt from the English test are eligible for GTA positions.
